function.arguments: {"index": 1, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The confounding between species and island does not invalidate the descriptive comparison of mean flipper length by species. The question asks which species has the highest mean flipper length — this is a descriptive claim about the data, not a causal inference. Even if island affects both species and flipper length, the observed mean difference is still a valid summary of the data. Therefore, the confounding does not change the estimand or the method. We can compute the raw mean per species and report the one with the highest value."}
function.name: resolve_finding
